svg.title: Editable reconstruction of multi-panel diffusion inversion and editing path comparison
svg.desc: Five dashed base frames labeled (a) DDIM, (b) NTI, NPI, (c) DirectINV, (d) SPDInv, and (e) DCI. Each frame contains gray latent forward chains, magenta noise paths, red reconstruction paths, purple inversion paths, green reconstruction paths, and additional reference, interaction, optimization, editing, and U-Net components. No SAM picture replacement is used because no confirmed picture assets were supplied; all visible content is constructed in native SVG.

g.desc: Panel (a) DDIM contains a top gray forward diffusion chain, a left magenta double-headed noise arc, a right red double-headed reconstruction arc, a purple inversion path in the middle, and a green reconstruction path along the bottom. Layout basis is left-right balance around the central inversion chain with top and bottom chains aligned horizontally.

Panel (b) NTI, NPI contains the DDIM-like top, magenta, red, purple, and green paths plus a blue reference path below and yellow interaction arrows between green and blue states. Layout basis is layered horizontal paths with vertical interaction pairs.

Panel (c) DirectINV contains a forward gray chain, magenta noise arc, red reconstruction indication near the terminal gray node, purple inversion path, green reconstruction path, and brown vertical optimization links between corresponding states. Layout basis is a broad central loop with paired vertical optimization arrows on the right.

Panel (d) SPDINV contains U-Net input to optimization connections, top gray forward chain, magenta noise arc, red reconstruction arc, purple inversion path with brown optimization loops, and green reconstruction path. Layout basis is a networked top-left U-Net feeding vertical optimization into the central inversion states.

Panel (e) DCI contains an upper image-reference fixed-point optimization module with a small photo-like reference image, encoder, U-Net, loss and frozen icons; below it are diffusion paths like DDIM plus a dashed editing separator and an orange high-edit-fidelity editing path. Layout basis is vertical separation of reference module, diffusion inversion module, and editing path module.
Legend maps colors and arrow styles: green reconstruction path, orange editing path, purple inversion path, blue reference path, yellow interaction, and brown optimization.
